section_path_text: GMS Week 47 - The Tide Of Second Thoughts
summary:
Main
After several weeks of improving confidence, recycling buyers are beginning to have second thoughts abouthow aggressively to pursue fresh tonnage. Bangladesh's recent optimism has been tempered by weaker steel, political unrest and sluggish domestic demand, prompting some buyers to reconsider their purchasing ideas or delay commitments. Elsewhere, sentiment remains selective rather than distressed.
